title: Sunrise Dream | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Newly Constructed Gulf Front House + Private Pool & Panoramic Gulf Views
description_expanded: Description: Sunrise Dream by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Beach Address: 151 Seaward Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Nestled along the glistening shores of the coveted 30A community in Dune Allen Beach, Sunrise Dream stands as a beacon of Gulf-front luxury within the exclusive, gated enclave of Sunrise Beach. Just a leisurely stroll from the village center, this newly constructed multi-million-dollar sanctuary radiates a bohemian coastal chic ambiance, with breathtaking coastal waters gracing every vista. Spanning over 4,000 square feet of modern elegance, this stunning home offers a pristine, private beach at your fingertips. Whether you're indulging in a refreshing dip in the private pool or retreating to one of the exquisite private suites, this promises to be a vacation etched in memory. An abundance of outdoor living awaits on the lanai and expansive balconies, while inside, multiple gathering spaces complement the generous private accommodations. Guests seeking 30A vacation rentals adorned with private pools, stunning beach views, and mesmerizing Gulf horizons are destined to be enchanted! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front -Over 4,000 Sq Ft -Parking Spaces: (3 Max) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: 6 At Kitchen Island -*Private Heated Pool *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 5 Bedrooms / 6 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths / 1 Outdoor Shower First Floor: - Entertainment Room with Sleeper Sofa and Full Bath - Pool Lanai -Laundry Room Second Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) - Living and Dining Area with Chef's Kitchen Plus Large Balcony with Panoramic Gulf and Beach Views - Half Bath Third Floor: - Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Separate Spa Shower), Large Balcony / Panoramic Gulf and Beach Views - Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower), Large Balcony / Panoramic Gulf and Beach Views - Bedroom 5: Two Twin Beds with Private Bath (Shower) Amenities Include: - Gated Community - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
